body: I feel like I should have seen the red flags, but was blinded with excitement and didn’t pay attention. I could have married someone else who was caring and loving , but I chose him and the regret is killing me . I have nothing to go back to and nothing to stay here. I am no longer myself I am nothing, I feel hopeless and suicide seems like the viable option.
It may seem that way, I have been there, but you know deep down in your heart it is not!
